title: Runtime Supervisor Projection
description: Content-light summary projection of runtime execution state. Derived from RuntimeAuditEvent records. Contains no raw file contents, stdout, stderr, diffs, snippets, or secrets.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the projection was built

status_counts.description: Count of invocations per status (completed, blocked, refused, failed)

changed_path_count.description: Total changed paths across recent invocations

changed_path_hashes.description: SHA-256 hashes of recent runtime results
